exposure: spontaneous VD in the preceding pregnancy
Women in Robson group 5 (RG5), defined as women with at least one previous cesarean section and a singleton term cephalic fetus
Mode of previous delivery (Cesarean section without labor or spontaneous vaginal delivery)
outcome: Eligibility for trial of labor after Cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Women in Robson group 5 (RG5) who delivered between 1998 and 2014 in Nova Scotia, Canada
finding: This study found that among women eligible for a TOLAC, high area-level income and either a cesarean section without labor or a spontaneous vaginal delivery in the preceding pregnancy were associated with a higher likelihood of vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that mode of previous delivery was a predictor of both TOLAC and vaginal delivery in eligible women, with previous cesarean section without labor being associated with lower odds of both outcomes.
